response: Socioeconomic status does matter when it comes to the quality of life in lung cancer patients. At baseline assessment, patients from lower socioeconomic backgrounds tend to have lower health-related quality of life. However, it's worth noting that the response to treatment is similar across different socioeconomic groups, suggesting that the impact of socioeconomic status on quality of life may be more significant at the initial stages. Overall, the findings indicate that quality of life is not only influenced by the disease and its treatment but is also highly dependent on each patient's socioeconomic characteristics.
